premises.text: Home automation adoption is blocked because lighting automation today is painful: wired switches need electricians or cannot be used in rentals, and smart bulbs break normal switch use
premises.evidence_span: Why is it that a product meant to make our lives simple and better is such a pain to deal with right out of the box?

premises.text: Switchmate snaps magnetically onto a standard light switch and mechanically flips it so users get phone-controlled smart lighting without rewiring or smart bulbs
premises.evidence_span: It uses two magnets on the back that snap right to the screws on your standard light switch. And it mechanically flips the switch up and down

premises.text: An optional hub serves as a base station for Switchmate and future easy-to-use smart-home products
premises.evidence_span: we'll be providing an optional hub that will serve as the base station for SwitchMate and any other feature products

premises.text: Go-to-market runs from pre-order/crowdfunding through online retail then brick-and-mortar, with an experienced manufacturing partner
premises.evidence_span: we're planning to launch a pre-order campaign. We're also working with a manufacturing partner

premises.text: Addressable market includes US homes and rentals with many automatable light switches
premises.evidence_span: There's about 120 million homes in the United States alone, a third of them being rentals and condos

value.text: Make the smart home / smart lighting extremely simple to use
value.evidence_span: on a mission to make the smart home simple

secondary_value.text: Peace of mind via vacation lighting timers and related use cases
secondary_value.evidence_span: leave on vacation with some peace of mind

causal_links.evidence_span: makes smart lighting extremely simple without dealing with any of these issues
we will never compromise on making sure we make products that are extremely simple to use
hope to deliver to online retail, such as Amazon, and through our own website

notes: Pain of wired switches vs smart bulbs folded into one problem-set premise (v1.5.1 #6). Vacation timers, geofencing, and manual/phone control folded into P2 as applications of one mechanism. Singleton D2 justified as separately launched hub/platform module.
